Title: The Debate Lord
Game logic: Pick a rival: their next stream starts with +1 Risk. Raids alone can't push a stream past 2 Risk.

Title: The Three-Hour Podcaster
Game logic: Start with +1 Sub Cap. Sub Cap upgrades cost 1 Cash more.

Title: The Giveaway King
Game logic: In your next stream, every viewer earns +1 Clout.

Title: The Mansion Socialist
Game logic: The richest rival pays you up to 2 Cash.

Title: Looks Hard, Is Soft
Game logic: When your stream gets deplatformed, you still bank half that stream's Clout.

Title: Two Heads, Zero Chill
Game logic: In your next stream, the first viewer action you use can be used again.

Title: Gotta Catch 'Em (Legally)
Game logic: Catch a random viewer from the shop (cost 6 or less, not a Play) for free.

Title: The Animated Proof
Game logic: Each great stream in a row earns +1, +2, +3... Clout (max +5). A failed stream resets it.

Title: Two-Time Back-to-Back Diagnostician
Cost and cooldown: 1 Cash (+1 per use), once per turn
Game logic: In your next stream, see the next 3 viewers in your queue.

Title: Classic rules
Game logic: Play the classic game without a streamer power.
